en.headline: LegCo condemns European Parliament remarks on Hong Kong
en.dek: A Legislative Council spokesman said a recommendation on EU-China relations made untrue allegations about the city and urged the parliament to stop.
body: A spokesman for the Legislative Council on Friday said the council resolutely opposed and severely condemned a European Parliament recommendation on EU-China political relations, which he said made untrue and biased allegations in the section on Hong Kong.

The statement, issued by the LegCo Secretariat, urged the European Parliament to stop what it called slander of Hong Kong's development and smears of its rule of law and human rights, and to stop interfering in Hong Kong affairs, which it said were China's internal affairs.

The spokesman said enacting and enforcing laws to safeguard national security was accepted international practice, and cited Hong Kong's rankings as a free economy, in competitiveness and as a financial centre as a rebuttal. He also said the European Parliament should not apply double standards to security legislation.
The European Parliament adopted the recommendation on Wednesday, local reports said. The LegCo statement did not quote a response from the parliament.

zh.headline: 立法會譴責歐洲議會有關香港的說法
zh.dek: 立法會發言人指歐中政治關係建議在香港部分作出失實偏頗指控，促請歐洲議會立即停止。
body: 立法會發言人周五表示，對歐洲議會有關歐中政治關係的建議予以堅決反對及嚴厲譴責，指建議在香港部分作出失實及偏頗指控。
立法會秘書處公布的聲明促請歐洲議會立即停止詆毀香港發展、抹黑本港法治及人權狀況，並停止以任何形式干涉發言人所稱純屬中國內政的香港事務。
發言人說，訂立及執行維護國家安全的法律是國際慣例，並以香港在經濟自由、競爭力及國際金融中心等方面的排名作為反駁。他又指歐洲議會不應以雙重標準看待本港的安全法例。
本地報道指歐洲議會於周三通過該建議。立法會聲明沒有引述歐洲議會的回應。
